title: Cisco ISE VPN + Intune Troubleshooting & Diagnostics Toolkit
hook: Find why the Cisco VPN + Intune handshake is failing — fast
problem: When certificate VPN or ISE posture stops working, the failure hides across four layers — the Intune cert/profile, the Entra app, the EAP-TLS chain, and ISE authorization. This toolkit gives you a structured root-cause tree and diagnostic scripts for the Cisco Secure Client + ISE + Intune stack so you isolate the failing layer in minutes instead of guessing — a self-guided troubleshooting playbook you keep and reuse.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the full Cisco-ISE-VPN + Intune signal path (cert issuance → profile apply → client connect → EAP-TLS → ISE posture/authorization) and the layered model behind the root-cause tree.
Requirements Guide — what you need to diagnose (Intune + Graph read access, device logs, the Secure Client/ISE live-log vantage points, an Entra app for compliance) with how to verify each.

Diagnostic Playbook — a structured root-cause decision tree by symptom (no cert, cert but no chain, client won't connect, EAP-TLS fails, connected but denied by posture), each with the exact checks and the layer it isolates.
5 PowerShell scripts — end-to-end diagnostic collection, certificate + chain validation, compliance/enrollment state check, VPN client + profile state check, and a consolidated diagnostics report.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides mapping each pass/fail gate to the fix, plus Best Practices for repeatable triage and escalation to Cisco with the right evidence.
short: A structured root-cause tree and diagnostic scripts for the Cisco Secure Client + ISE + Intune stack — isolate a failing cert, profile, EAP-TLS, or posture layer in minutes. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: A structured root-cause tree and diagnostic scripts for the Cisco Secure Client + ISE + Intune stack — isolate a failing cert, profile, EAP-TLS, or posture layer in minutes.
